stories.title: Pakistan to host 30th ECO Council of Ministers meeting on Nov 15-16
stories.brief: The meeting will be chaired by Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar and attended by foreign ministers and heads of delegations from ECO member states, along with representatives of the organisation’s secretariat and subsidiary bodies, the FO said in a statement.

stories.title: Pakistan to host 30th ECO Council of Foreign Ministers meeting on Nov 15-16
stories.brief: The 30th Meeting of the Economic Cooperation Organisation (ECO) Council of Foreign Ministers will be held in Islamabad on November 15-16, with Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar set to chair the meeting, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) said on Saturday.

stories.title: Presidency denies discussion on new units with Naqvi
stories.brief: "There is no truth to media reports suggesting that matters concerning the provinces were discussed during the interior minister's meeting with the president," the President House said in a statement. "Matters concerning national security and the regional situation were discussed during the meeting.

stories.title: President House says matters related to provinces did not come under discussion during Zardari, Naqvi meeting
stories.brief: The President House on Friday refuted media reports about yesterday’s meeting between President Asif Ali Zardari and Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, saying that discussions focused on national security and regional situation.

stories.title: Setback for SpaceX Starship rocket's double-catch test
stories.brief: Elon Musk’s company aborted an attempted catch of the rocket’s booster - instead it came down in the ocean.

stories.title: Sindh decides to replace petrol vehicles with EVs
stories.brief: KARACHI: The Sindh government has decided to gradually replace conventional vehicles used in government departments with electric vehicles (EVs), in a move aimed at cutting expenditure, saving fuel and reducing pollution. The senior minister said that the gradual transition to EVs would also help reduce the day-to-day expenditure of government departments.

stories.title: EVs to replace Sindh govt's official vehicles
stories.brief: The Sindh government is planning to phase out conventional vehicles used by provincial departments and replace them with electric vehicles (EVs) in a move aimed at cutting fuel costs and promoting environment-friendly transport. The meeting reviewed measures to reduce government expenditure, conserve fuel and assess the vehicle requirements of various provincial departments.

stories.title: Microsoft says services fully restored after day-long global outage
stories.brief: Efforts to address the underlying problem with Outlook, Teams and Copilot are complete, the tech firm says.

stories.title: Trump, Xi and Putin to hold first three-way summit in China
stories.brief: White House says Trump plans to discuss the Iran war and nuclear arms at a meeting on the sidelines of APEC next week.

stories.title: New provinces not anyone's wish but Pakistan's need: Mustafa Kamal
stories.brief: Earlier this month, Kamal had reiterated his support for the creation of new provinces, saying Pakistan couldn't be governed under the existing administrative model and that the creation of new administrative units had become inevitable.

stories.title: Pakistan urges end to attacks on Gulf states, calls for regional de-escalation
stories.brief: Pakistan has called for an end to military provocations and attacks in the Gulf region, urging the protection of civilians and commercial shipping and the pursuit of diplomatic solutions amid heightened regional tensions.

stories.title: SC says time cannot erase inheritance rights
stories.brief: The Supreme Court has ruled that an heir's right to inheritance takes effect immediately upon the death of the property owner and does not require the acceptance or consent of other heirs.

stories.title: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
stories.brief: Trump will discuss the "reduction of nuclear weapons" during the unprecedented talks, a spokeswoman says.

stories.title: Jojo the gorilla has spent his life alone. Can he finally find a companion?
stories.brief: Jojo was poached as an infant and grew up in captivity. His keepers want to find him a friend - but it's not straightforward.

stories.title: How the Jensen Huang scandal created a headache for business-friendly Singapore
stories.brief: The scandal has cast a spotlight on Singapore's success as a chip hub - and a location for alleged illicit trade.

stories.title: Tuchel to remind England players of anti-racism protocols before game in Spain
stories.brief: Spain won 1-0 at the Bernabéu but the occasion was ruined by racist abuse directed at England’s black players from the stands.England have since played three games in Spain, although they refused to return to Madrid for the first of them in 2009.

stories.title: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
stories.brief: Microsoft says it is continuing to restore services including Outlook and Teams following a global outage.
